experiment: E3 calibration-point quantity and spatial-distribution sensitivity

distributions.spread: 100 valid candidate subsets with the highest spatial coverage scores.
distributions.random: 100 uniformly selected valid candidate subsets excluding the selected spread and clustered extremes.
distributions.clustered: 100 valid candidate subsets with the lowest spatial coverage scores.

spatial_score: 0.5 * normalized convex-hull coverage + 0.5 * normalized mean pairwise distance
degeneracy_rule: Subsets with convex-hull coverage below 0.01 are rejected to avoid collinear or near-collinear calibration geometries.
important_statistical_note: Subset trials are offline calibration-design resamples and are not independent physical experimental repeats.
